categories.SHELL: App-level chrome mounted once in src/App.jsx around every route, outside any page component.
categories.HERO: The first block of a page: title-bearing banner or split hero that opens the route.
categories.CONTENT: Explanatory body modules: feature grids, alternating rows, value grids, timelines, FAQs.
categories.PROOF: Social proof and evidence: logos, impact stats, quotes, testimonials, case-study blocks.
categories.MEDIA: Blocks whose primary payload is a video (inline loop or click-to-play embed).
categories.PRICING: Plan cards and onboarding steps specific to the pricing route.
categories.CONVERSION: Blocks whose job is a call to action: CTA bands, image CTAs, forms, sign-up cards.
categories.LISTING: Collection indexes and teasers: filters, card grids, news tiles, job lists, popups over a grid.
categories.ARTICLE: Blocks inside the white article shell of a collection detail route.
